title: Alligatorbellow1
author: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
changes: Recording of an American alligator (Alligator mississippiensis), a crocodilian cousin of the crocodile. Trimmed to 1.55–4.15 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
